text_block_list.text: The day of Yukino Bijin's mock race—

Having overseen her training with Sakura 
Bakushin O, I was curious about the race 
results, so I headed over to spectate.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, hello there~.
choice_data_list: Glad to see you're not nervous.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My mind's already made up. It's all thanks 
to both of you~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to run and win! Do your 
very best, Yukino-san!
choice_data_list: Show them how cool you can be!
Show them the fruits of your training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You bet I will!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was talkin' to everyone from back home 
just now, and they're really countin' on 
me—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So there ain't no way I'm gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna take 1st place so everyone thinks 
Yukino's turned into an amazin' 
umamusume...!

Yukino Bijin walked away with steady, 
resolute steps. The look on her face was 
completely different from before her 
training.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll give it everything Bakushin 
O-san taught me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You are an umamusume personally raised by 
the Class President! You will most 
certainly take 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ! I'll run with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right! Your master will be watching over 
you from the stands the entire time!

After parting ways with Yukino Bijin, I 
waited for the race to start alongside 
Sakura Bakushin O, who was acting like a 
proud master.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, is that you? I spotted your banner 
just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's from everyone back home! They 
came all this way just to watch my race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same desire to bring joy 
to everyone back in my hometown. I will 
not lose today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Oguri-san wants to win just as badly... 
But I—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Yukino Bijiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: E... Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! I'm Yukino Bijin! I'll do my best 
with my snowy-country grit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...I really do wanna get 1st place after 
all! I wanna show 'em my cool side and 
have 'em say I'm just like a 'city girl'!)

The runners finished their greetings, and 
before long, the race was underway.

Though Oguri Cap was heavily favored, 
early on, one umamusume pulled off an 
unexpected breakaway—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can step up when it counts too! I won't 
lose to Oguri-san, or anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll show ya the spirit of Moriokaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohh!! Yukino-san is pulling further 
and further away from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That terrifying momentum... Truly 
Class President-grade...!

She might actually pull this off... 
Holding my breath, I watched the race 
unfold, but—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I've caught up to you, 
Yukino...!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-Not yet! I'm not givin' up 1st 
place...!!

Demonstrating a terrifying surge, Oguri 
Cap rapidly closed the distance between 
herself and Yukino Bijin. Yukino Bijin 
accelerated in response, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
It's Oguri! Oguri pulled off the 
overtake...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
That Yukino girl fought hard, but ended up 
in 2nd, huh. Man, Oguri really is crazy 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I blew it... I couldn't show 'em my 
cool side at all, waaah...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That isn't true. ...Can't you hear 
everyone's voices?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on 2nd place, Yukino-chan! You're 
the pride of Morioka!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan... You've grown so splendid! 
Why, you're practically a full-fledged 
'city girl' now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mister... Ma'am...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The cheering just won't stop... It's 
almost like endless bowls of wanko soba.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I... managed to run a race that everyone 
can hold their heads high about, didn't 
I...)

Though she finished in 2nd place, by 
giving it her absolute all, Yukino Bijin 
seemed to have grown both mentally and 
physically.
